source.origin: Exported from the HNL phenomenology notebook. Leptonic and partonic matrix elements use the generator's daughter masses (m1/m2/m3). The 88 branching-ratio grids and total-width table are unchanged. Charged-current conjugate rows are separate; together they carry the Majorana width. No radiative N -> nu gamma row is included.
